cues.text: Before we start, here's what I use and why. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult a healthcare provider for personal medical decisions. Say allow to continue.
Thanks. You can change this anytime.

One doctor each, in their own plan. Book all three?
Alexa, I've met my out-of-pocket max this year. I want a full checkup: primary care, OB-GYN, a dermatologist, a gastroenterologist and lab work. Book them all before my plan resets.
Your gastroenterologist is already booked for Thursday. Tuesday, same clinic: primary care, then OB-GYN. Friday: dermatology. All while he's at daycare. Book these three?
Booked. Details in your Alexa app and email. Say cancel anytime.
Alexa, what's left on my checkup plan?
Four booked. Lab work comes after Tuesday's visit.

I checked six nearby. Two don't see children under three, one isn't in his plan. These two fit.
